summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new auth-gated features (JWT httpOnly cookies, chat, image gen, TTS, attachments, user-scoped keys, image/video creator models, Try-in-Chat deeplink). 25/25 pytest backend tests passed; all critical frontend flows verified live.

action_items: (Optional/low) Remove <span>-wrapped icons from <option> children in ChatDemo.jsx to silence React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth implementation is solid: bcrypt hashes ($2b$), httpOnly+secure+samesite=none cookies, 15m access / 7d refresh, brute-force lockout (5 attempts / 15 min), idempotent seed_admin that also updates the password if ADMIN_PASSWORD changed.
Chat/keys/usage/image/voice all correctly gated behind auth (verified 401 without cookies, 200 with cookies).
Keys are properly user-scoped: user A's key not visible/deletable by user B (verified).
Public routes /api/court and /api/v1/chat still function correctly without user auth.
MongoDB _id is properly projected out of responses.
server.py is 749 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting PayPal and voice/image handlers into separate routers for maintainability.
